Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I know this was discussed when it first came up, but I don't think
I ever saw a clear answer.
What's considered a "regular" strike, for purposes of Concealed
Weapon's limitation?

Can Shambling Hordes with Strength 3 equip with a concealed Meat Hook,
which strikes for Str+1 damage?
i.e. Should "Strength" on weapon cards be read as "1" for purposes of
the new CW? Or is the limitation based upon the minion doing the
equipping?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> I know this was discussed when it first came up, but I don't think
> I ever saw a clear answer.
> What's considered a "regular" strike, for purposes of Concealed
> Weapon's limitation?

A regular strike by a regular minion against a regular opponent
(i.e., assuming nothing about the striker, the strikee, or modifiers
to the strike).

> Can Shambling Hordes with Strength 3 equip with a concealed Meat Hook,
> which strikes for Str+1 damage?

Yes. Meat Hook does 2 damage with a regular strike.
